title: Resize Paths Across the Harborline VPS and Dedicated Servers Range
content:
Each tier of the VPS and Dedicated Servers range lists the tiers it can be resized up to in the middle of a term, whether it can be resized to a smaller tier, and the expected downtime of a resize. Disk can never shrink.

| Tier | Tiers it can be resized up to mid-term | Resize to a smaller tier allowed | Expected downtime of a resize (minutes) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline VPS 2 GB | Harborline VPS 4 GB, Harborline VPS 8 GB, Harborline VPS 16 GB | No | 10 |
| Harborline VPS 4 GB | Harborline VPS 8 GB, Harborline VPS 16 GB | No | 10 |
| Harborline VPS 8 GB | Harborline VPS 16 GB | No | 10 |
| Harborline VPS 16 GB | None | No | 10 |
| Harborline Dedicated Standard | None | No | 0 |
| Harborline Dedicated Enterprise | None | No | 0 |

## Reading the chart

- A server can move only to a tier listed in its own row. Harborline VPS 16 GB lists none, and neither does either Harborline Dedicated tier.
- No tier can be resized to a smaller tier.
- A move from Harborline VPS 2 GB straight to Harborline VPS 16 GB is listed in the Harborline VPS 2 GB row and needs no intermediate tier.
